# expo_update_branch (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "expo_update_branch" "production" {
  app_id = expo_app.this.id
  name   = "production"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) The id of the app the update branch belongs to
- `name` (String) The name of the update branch

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the update branch
